Mathematical Purpose & Rationale: Converts nominal categories to sparse orthogonal vectors without imposing ordinal bias.
Standardizes features to zero mean and unit variance: z = (x - mu) / sigma; critical for distance-based k-NN.
Integrates encoded categorical matrices and standardized numerical arrays into a unified matrix.
Encoder categories and scaler parameters (mu, sigma) learned strictly from 1990-2012 data.
